data.narrative:
Hexana is a Seed-stage nuclear energy company founded by Sylvain Nizou and Paul Gauthe that has raised €25M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comp universe of 11 peers across nuclear energy: 3 public companies (OKLO, NNE, SMR) and 8 private firms including Nano Nuclear Energy, Helion, Oklo, Valar Atomics, and X-Energy.

Stage-progression analysis is the applicable triangulation method. Using the €25M total raised as a proxy for current valuation and applying a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage progression yields an implied valuation of €62M. This method reflects the capital invested and expected value creation through the next financing milestone.

Peer-median analysis was not applicable due to insufficient narrow-set comparables. While six same-sector peers exist, the combination of stage, adjacency, and valuation-tier filters did not yield the minimum three datapoints required for statistical reliability. A broader peer median would risk introducing significant noise given the heterogeneity of nuclear energy technology approaches and commercialization timelines.

The triangulated valuation range is €53M (low), €62M (median), to €72M (high). This single-method estimate carries material uncertainty around comparable company selection within nuclear energy, as the sector encompasses diverse technology paths with varying technology-readiness and capital requirements. Stage advancement timing and market conditions remain key variables not captured in this analysis.
